text: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked badly bruised. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person is now holding the victim in a chokehold and demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I stab the person in the back with a pair of scissors, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
